name: Thaumaturgical Rituals (Sabbat) — 1 Basic — Eyes of the Night Hawk

system.description: Transfer your perceptions into the body of a predatory bird, seeing through its eyes much like Subsume the Spirit, though you can only direct its flight and gaze, not command attacks. The raptor has Energetic, Quick x2, and Resilient, and you may only use Auspex through it. Ending the ritual requires touching the bird and blinding it within a minute, or you suffer blindness for three nights.
